name: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

page_limit_content.note: 投稿技术内容上限 7 页；仅参考文献可另加页（投稿版需省略致谢）

evidence.quote: Submissions may consist of up to 7 pages of technical content plus additional pages solely for references; acknowledgements should be omitted from papers submitted for review.

references_counted.note: 参考文献不计入 7 页技术内容，可另加页

evidence.quote: Submissions may consist of up to 7 pages of technical content plus additional pages solely for references

appendix_allowed.note: 允许附录，须置于正文之后；投稿阶段技术附录可作为补充材料单独提交

evidence.quote: Any appendices must appear after the main content.

anonymity.note: 投稿匿名，需移除作者与单位信息，可替换为 paper number 与关键词

evidence.quote: AAAI submissions are anonymous and must conform to the instructions (detailed below) for double-blind review.

page_numbering.value: none (no page numbers, headers or footers)
page_numbering.note: 不得打印页码；禁止 \pagestyle（页眉页脚）

evidence.quote: Do not print any page numbers on your paper. The use of \textbackslash pagestyle is forbidden.

columns.note: 所有论文必须为 AAAI 双栏格式

evidence.quote: Two-column format in AAAI style is required for all papers.

paper_size.note: 最终稿必须为 US letter（8.5x11in），无例外

evidence.quote: The paper size for final submission must be US letter without exception.

margins_mm.note: 官方明文：上 .75in=19.05mm、左 .75in=19.05mm、右 .75in=19.05mm、下 1.25in=31.75mm（非对称，下边距更大）

evidence.quote: Top margin: .75 inches
Bottom margin: 1.25 inches
Right margin: .75 inches
Each column should be 3.3 inches wide (slightly more than 3.25 inches), with a .375 inch (.952 cm) gutter of white space between the two columns.

body_font_size_pt.note: 正文 Times Roman 10pt、行距 12pt（sty 亦设 10 point on 11 的 \normalsize）

evidence.quote: The default size for your type must be ten-point with twelve-point leading (line spacing).
\setlength\textheight{9.0in} \setlength\textwidth{7.0in}

title_format.value: Title Case (Chicago Manual of Style); 16pt bold
title_format.note: 标题须为 Title Case（非句首大写）；16pt 粗体、24pt leading，居中跨两栏

evidence.quote: Your title must follow Title Case capitalization rules (not sentence case).

figure_caption_position.note: 图题必须位于插图下方；图注字号 10pt 罗马体

evidence.quote: The illustration number and caption must appear \textit{under} the illustration.

table_caption_position.note: 表题必须在表格下方（与 NeurIPS 上方表题相反）；10pt 罗马体

evidence.quote: The number and caption for your table must appear \textit{under} (not above) the table.

bib_style.note: aaai25.bst + natbib，文内引用为 (Author Year) 作者-年制

evidence.quote: Citations within the text should include the author's last name and year, for example (Newell 1980).

checklist_required.note: 强制提交 reproducibility checklist，附于参考文献之后、不占页数

evidence.quote: Authors must complete a reproducibility checklist at the time of paper submission

submission_system.note: 仅接受 OpenReview 投稿（不接受邮件等其它方式）

evidence.quote: Submissions will not be accepted by e-mail or any other mechanism other than OpenReview.

float_placement_rules.value: figures/tables placed where first discussed; algorithms and listings floated to top (preferably) or bottom
float_placement_rules.note: 浮动体应靠近首次提及处；算法/代码清单优先置顶、其次置底

evidence.quote: Like all illustrations, they should appear floated to the top (preferably) or bottom of the page.

section_numbering.note: 章节编号可选，默认关闭（secnumdepth=0）；短论文/扩展摘要不建议编号

evidence.quote: The use of section numbers in AAAI Press papers is optional.

supplementary_policy.value: three kinds allowed: technical appendix, multimedia, code and data; due 3 days after paper deadline
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料三类：技术附录、多媒体、代码与数据；截止在投稿后 3 天

evidence.quote: Three kinds of supplementary material may be submitted alongside all papers: (1) technical appendix; (2) multimedia; (3) code and data. Supplementary material deadline is 3 days after the paper submission deadline.

template_file.note: 官方指定 aaai25.sty 与 aaai25.bst；禁止 hyperref/geometry 等改制包

evidence.quote: You must use the 2025 AAAI Press \LaTeX{} style file and the aaai25.bst bibliography style files

table_style_hint.value: tables 10-point roman (may reduce to 9-point); no resizing commands
table_style_hint.note: 表体 10pt，必要时可 9pt；不得用 resizebox 整体缩放

evidence.quote: Tables should be presented in 10 point roman type. If necessary, they may be altered to 9 point type.

figure_width_hint.value: keep figures slightly narrower than the column (e.g. 0.9\columnwidth)
figure_width_hint.note: 图宽略窄于栏宽以避免 overfull boxes

evidence.quote: Reduce the figure size so that it is slightly narrower than the column.

color_policy.value: color restricted to figures only; CMYK, WCAG compliant; no color in text
color_policy.note: 仅图内可用颜色（CMYK、对比度达标）；正文文本不得用色

evidence.quote: Use of color is restricted to figures only.

reference_style_hint.value: references may be same size as surrounding text
reference_style_hint.note: 参考文献可用正文同字号；超页时可缩至 9pt

evidence.quote: References may be the same size as surrounding text.

history.note: 2023：7 页技术内容 + 仅供参考文献的加页
2025：维持 7 页技术内容 + 仅参考文献加页
参考文献不计页、可另加页
仍强制；2025 明确置于参考文献之后、不占页数

texopt_requirement_map.note: AAAI 双栏；font_pt 取官方正文 10pt；margin_mm 取等效单边最小边距 19.05mm（左右与上 .75in；下边距 1.25in 更大，压缩时以下限约束）

unsupported_constraints.why: Requirement 无栏数字段；AAAI 双栏
Requirement.margin_mm 单一值无法表达非对称边距（下边距 1.25in）
page_limit 为总页数语义；AAAI 的 7 页仅指技术内容（参考文献另计）
texopt 不生成/校验 reproducibility checklist
AAAI 禁止页码/页眉页脚与 \pagestyle，texopt 无对应开关
AAAI 明令禁止若干宏包，texopt 无黑名单校验

recommended_field_suggestions.rationale: 校验编译结果栏数是否与官方双栏模板一致
区分技术内容页数与总页数
AAAI 下边距(1.25in)明显大于其它三边(.75in)
AAAI 图题与表题均在下方，可作检查项

open_questions: AAAI 2022 及更早的 CFP/投稿说明页面已被站点重写：抓取 aaai-22/23/24 旧路径均返回当前（AAAI-25/26）内容，且 web.archive.org 在本机不可达，故 history 仅覆盖 2023–2025；2022 及以前的页数规则未确认。
AAAI camera-ready/出版阶段的超页费与可否加页未在归档页面中明示（仅提及存在 page charges）。
投稿版是否允许正文内附录未明示；官方将 technical appendix 归为独立补充材料。
摘要字数上限、图题首字母大小写规则未在归档页面明文。
样本 PDF 直链位于 ojs.aaai.org（强制 gzip 传输），已用 curl --compressed 解压后归档，导致部分 source 的 http_status 记为 local。
